name: hanfei1986/Python-GUI-for-overflow-SQL-data-retrieving

Usually, we can use the "WHERE ID IN ("ID1","ID2","ID3", ...)" clause to specify the records we want to retrieve. However, SQL can only handle limited amount of records at a time. When I built this app, I used a split-retrieve-concatenate strategy.
